$comment: TM-5401 traction motor twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the locomotive data sheet, the motor data and the converter data; the TCMS sends only what it measures.

identification.model: Asynchronous traction motor, axle 1 of a Vectron AC Bo'Bo' locomotive (motor type: see the nameplate)
identification.description: Traction motor 1 of locomotive 5401 with its IGBT traction inverter, blower and bearings, monitored through the TCMS
identification.vehicle: Siemens Vectron AC, 6.4 MW, 200 km/h, Bo'Bo', freight and passenger
identification.motor: Three-phase asynchronous (squirrel-cage induction) traction motor, forced ventilation from a traction-motor blower
identification.drive: Motor in the bogie driving the axle through a single-stage gear (assumed nose-suspended)
identification.inverter: IGBT traction inverter, one per motor (assumed), water-glycol cooled

locomotive.source: Siemens Mobility Vectron brochure (MOML-B10020-03-7600) and Vectron 230 km/h data sheet: 6,400 kW max. power at wheel, 160 / 200 km/h, approx. 85 t (max. 90 t), Bo'Bo', wheels 1,250 mm new / 1,160 mm worn, starting tractive effort 320 kN (350 kN where authorised), electric braking effort 240 kN.

motor.source: Power and starting effort per motor = locomotive values / 4 (published). Gear ratio 4.0, gear efficiency 0.98, motor efficiency 0.955, rated current 530 A and magnetising current 150 A: assumption: typical value, replace with the motor data sheet / type test report. Base speed, rpm, rated torque and current per torque are derived from these in build_twin.py.

thermal.source: Winding rise of 125 K over the cooling air at rated RMS current and full blower flow, rise proportional to current squared and to (rated flow / flow)^0.8, hot spot 10 K above the winding sensor: assumption: typical value, replace with the motor data sheet / type test report. Thermal class 200 (IEC 60085); 20 000 h at the class temperature and life halved per 10 K (Montsinger) are commonly applied approximations; reference temperature 150 C (640 000 h by that rule) chosen for the ageing rate.

bearings.de: insulated cylindrical roller bearing (drive end, pinion side)
bearings.nde: insulated deep groove ball bearing (non-drive end)
bearings.source: Bearing types typical of traction motors (current-insulated to stop converter bearing currents). Temperature rise over the cooling air of 40 K at maximum speed, 14 rollers of 32 mm on a 190 mm pitch circle: assumption: typical value, replace with the motor data sheet / type test report.

insulation.source: Insulation resistance of a dry, clean winding at 40 C, and halving per 10 K for the temperature correction (the usual approximation used with IEEE 43): assumption: typical value, replace with the motor data sheet / type test report.

adhesion.source: Adhesion available on dry rail with sanding and normal creep of the slip control at full effort: assumption, typical values; 320 kN on 85 t needs about 0.38.

converter.source: Inverter losses 25 kW at rated current (40 % proportional to current, 60 % to current squared), heat-sink thermal resistance 1.2 K/kW, coolant 45 C, 60 stop-start cycles a day, 30-year design life: assumption: typical value, replace with the motor data sheet / type test report. LESIT power-cycling parameters A, alpha, Ea as commonly quoted from Held et al. (1997); kB = Boltzmann constant. LESIT describes 1990s modules: replace with the module maker's power-cycling curve.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 15 times faster, so the 30-minute averages settle in 2 minutes and one 40-minute run (stand, start, climb, cruise, coast, brake) takes 160 s of real time.

groups.Insulation: Insulation test at the last stop

Envelope acceleration at the outer-race frequency (DE)

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

blower_degraded.name: Traction-motor blower or air filter degraded
blower_degraded.symptoms: blower flow down, winding hotter but as the reduced flow explains, insulation ages faster

cooling_ducts_blocked.name: Motor cooling ducts blocked (dust, brake dust, oil mist)
cooling_ducts_blocked.symptoms: flow normal, winding hotter than the load and the flow explain, insulation ages faster

bearing_lubrication.name: Bearing grease loss or degraded grease (drive end)
bearing_lubrication.symptoms: drive-end bearing hotter than speed explains, vibration still normal

bearing_outer_race.name: Bearing outer race defect (drive end, spalling or fluting)
bearing_outer_race.symptoms: envelope acceleration at the outer-race frequency up, temperature still normal

insulation_moisture.name: Winding insulation moisture or contamination
insulation_moisture.symptoms: insulation resistance at 40 C falls below the minimum

low_adhesion.name: Low adhesion: wheel slip (leaves, sanding fault)
low_adhesion.symptoms: creep above normal under traction, many slip corrections, effort capped by adhesion

rotor_cage_damage.name: Rotor cage damage (cracked bar or end ring)
rotor_cage_damage.symptoms: less torque than demanded, more current per unit of torque

inverter_cooling.name: Inverter cooling degraded (pump, coolant, fouled cooler)
inverter_cooling.symptoms: IGBT baseplate hotter than the current explains, bigger and hotter junction cycles, life shortens
